Blair.MarriageDialogue.spring_1: Hey, babe!#$b#Would you like some help with spring cleaning at home?
Blair.MarriageDialogue.spring_12: There's gonna be tons of eggs tomorrow!$h#$b#What do you think about having an egg fight after the egg hunt?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.spring_23: Sooooooo, how does it feel to take the most beautiful girl to the dance tomorrow?$6#$b#You must be thanking the mountain spirit right now.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.summer_1: Hot girl summer! Woohoo!$h#$b#We should make beach plans, babe.#$b#It would be such a waste if we kept our hotness to ourselves. That would be cruel to the rest of the valley.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.summer_10: Watch out for my outfit tomorrow, babe.#$b#I'll make your jaw drop.$4#$b#Maybe I can show you my hula moves, too... however bad they may be, hehe.$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.summer_27: Hey, babe? Maybe we could pack a picnic blanket tomorrow?#$b#We could lay down and watch the stars while waiting for the jellies to arrive.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.fall_1: Fall, ech.$u#$b#This season usually means sweeping every day.$u#$e#The only good thing about it, though, is that it's breezier than summer.$h#$b#Which means more hugs!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.fall_15: We should make a game plan for what to do tomorrow.#$b#Should we separate and cover more ground, like divide-and-conquer? Or should we team up and take them on together?$7
Blair.MarriageDialogue.fall_19: Are you excited about tomorrow, babe?#$b#People will definitely be asking us about a lot of things. Especially newlywed stuff... If ya know what I mean.$9
Blair.MarriageDialogue.fall_26: What are you going to dress as tomorrow, babe?#$b#We could dress as 'Bobbie and Clyve'! Flor was mumbling about this couple who's so iconic they made a book about them!$h#$b#We'd be the talk of the town!$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.winter_1: Brr, winter is the best season for hot chocolate!$h#$b#And lots of cuddles!$4#$b#And last but not the least, SNOWBALL FIGHTS!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.winter_7: I've been thinking about what better baits there are to use for the festival of ice tomorrow.$7#$b#The competition really gets me riled up!$h#$b#We have to show them we're the best, babe!$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.winter_24: I know it's a tradition to make a wish tomorrow.#$b#But honestly... What more could I wish for?$6#$b#I'm already so happy with you and I feel content with everything that we have in our life right now.$4
I did a good job decorating the room, didn't I?#$b#I think I could help Kiarra and Anton whenever they have a gig.$h#$e#Yes, I think I'm that good, babe!$7#$b#Why? Are you going to disagree?$h

I've been wanting to get my own little nook since I was younger.#$b#I love what I did with this room because it doesn't look too "fishy", you know?$h#$e#On a serious note though, I like that I get to be able to do things on my own.$h#$b#And also with you, of course!$4

We should get some board games, babe.$h#$b#Ooh, and also sets of cards!$h#$b#That way we could play bets on who has the more drawings in the face first.$4#$b#I'll give you a wager right now that the one to have the most would be you.$h

Hmm, babe. Do you think the room's too purpley-pinkish?$u#$b#I just realized that other people might think I'm too chica.$h#$b#It'll be hard to keep my cool reputation if they think that...$h#$e#Oh well, I'm always cool no matter what color my room is!$7

Do you know something, babe?#$b#One thing I appreciate about us is that our conversations can get so random at times, but it feels normal to us.$7#$e#I really think it's cute.$h#$b#I think we're cute!$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.patio_Blair.1: I can't get enough of your face, babe!$4#$b#There's just something about it that makes me want to squish you!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.patio_Blair.2: Hmm, this fishnet...$7#$b#Maybe I could get Faye to make some custom fishnets that have tinier holes. I think it'd catch more fish. Don't you think so too, babe?
Blair.MarriageDialogue.patio_Blair.3: Ah, fresh air!$h#$b#Maybe I could get Corine and Ysa to join me when I try to do yoga for the first time.#$e#That is, if I can get Miss Pretty-Pink Ysa to be around fishes.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.patio_Blair.4: %Blair proceeds to inhale a large amount of air.#$b#Phe-ew.$u#$b#Babe, did you fart?$u#$e#Haha, kidding! I was just messing with you!$h#$b#I love you, baby!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.patio_Blair.5: Ay dios mio!$u#$b#I almost face-planted into that pail of water!$u#$e#Hehe, I guess I'm a little clumsy.$4#$b#I'm sorry, baby. I'll watch my step next time.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_0: Rain, rain, go away!$h#$b#Just kidding, I love the rain.$h#$e#It's kind of weird for me to enjoy rain though because fishes are hard to find whenever it's raining.#$b#But I still enjoy it.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_1: Man, it's really coming down out here.$7#$b#I hope the fishes don't hide too much.$s
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_2: Ayayay, wet wet wet.$u#$b#Craaaazy rain, ayayay.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_3: I want to take a shower in the rain, baby.$6#$b#What do you say? Let's go out and take a shower on our patio?$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_4: The good thing about rainy days is that it's not scorching hot.$h#$b#That sun seems so angry these days.$u
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_Blair: Honeybunch sugarpluuuuum!$6#$b#Teehee! Nothing, babe! I just felt like calling you!$4#$b#The rain seems to be making me crazier than normal.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_0: Ooh, you look awfully good while wet, babe.$7#$b#Would you like to continue whatever it is you're doing at home?$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_1: Damn, babe!$4#$b#It must be a crime to douse you with water!$h#$b#You look awfully good.$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_2: Ugh, I've had enough of this rain.$s#$b#I want to have clear skies already, babe!$u
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_3: I've been thinking about different things to do in the rain...$6#$e#And...$6#$b#I had an idea that will require us both to be in the bedroom.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_4: Don't you just love how the rain quenches the thirst of the land?$h#$b#But I do hope the fishes don't drown!$7#$b#Haha! Just kidding!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_5: Hmm, babe?#$b#Why don't we come home and just go out when the rain is over?$6#$b#I'm sure we could keep ourselves occupied if we really put our heads together.$4#$e#Or maybe we could occupy ourselves out here in the rain?$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_Blair: Man, it really is raining cats and dogs today.#$e#Teehee, imagine if it really was raining cats and dogs!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_0: Baaaaabe!$h#$e#Hehe, oh nothing! I just enjoy calling you.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_1: Oh my Yoba! BABE! I just found out that you stole something!$u#$b#You stole my heart!$4#$e#Hehe! I'm just being silly, babe.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_2: Hey, babe?#$b#I've been thinking, do you think fishes talk with their mouths full?#$b#I mean, their mouth is always full of water.$6#$e#Haha! I don't even know why that thought went inside my head.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_3: Random thoughts have been entering my head lately.$7#$b#Like incredibly random out-of-this-world kind of thoughts. Like fishes crawling instead of swimming.$u#$e#It must be a good thing that you love me so much, huh, babe?$4#$b#Or else you might think I'm crazy!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_4: What are you up to today, babe?#$b#Do you need a good luck kiss from the best wife ever?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_Blair: You must've done something good in your past life, babe.#$b#For you to be so blessed with an amazing wife like me, I think you must have been at least deity-level in the past.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_0: My Yoba, what a day!$u#$b#That was tiring.$s#$b#But boy am I glad to see you, babe!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_1: The farm looks abundant, babe!$h#$b#I'm proud to say that I'm the best good luck charm you have.$h#$e#Haha, just kidding!$h#$b#You've been doing great work on the farm, babe.#$b#You the best!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_2: It's kind of quiet tonight, babe?#$b#Why don't we make some noise of our own...?$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_3: Ugh, I feel so tired, baby.$s#$b#Could we just hug each other on the bed?$s
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_4: Did you finish all your tasks for today, baby?#$e#If you feel tired I could do a 'karate chop' massage for you.$h#$b#Just kidding, babe.$h#$b#I'll be gentle, I promise.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_Blai: Congratulations, babe!$h#$b#You get to sleep beside the most amazing woman in the valley, me!$h#$b#Haha, isn't it a gift to have me every day and night?$h#$e#Kidding aside though, babe... I feel lucky to be able to come home to my best friend every day.$4#$b#I love you, @.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_0: What should we do tuh-day, babe?$h#$b#Maybe we could race to the Ridge, if you're not too busy?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_1: The bees frolicking around the flowers remind me of you, babe.#$b#You're the bee frolicking around me, the pretty little flower.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_2: Could you fetch me some refreshments in your free time, babe?#$b#I'd really enjoy some drinks - along with your company, of course.$h#$b#It would be a great distraction from all the work I have today.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_3: I'm dripping in sweat, babe.$7#$b#But even then, it just makes me look even hotter. Right, babe?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_4: Hey there, babe.$h#$b#If you happen to stop by at Willy's could you grab a hook for me? I think I misplaced mine.$s
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Blair.2: I'm thinking about fishing on the Ridge today.#$b#I heard there are magical entities that help you there. Maybe I'll find my lucky charm there.#$e#Oh poo, don't feel bad. You're still the best lucky charm that I have. I just have to look for one that's meant for fishing, and fishing only.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Blair.3: Bye, baby!#$b#Don't miss me too much, okay?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Blair.4: I'm off to the village, babe.#$b#Mom will be loca if I don't visit her every once in a while.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Blair.5: Ayayay, as much as I don't want to leave you... I'm afraid the fishes will miss me.$s#$b#So hang tight, baby. I'll be back later, okay?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Blair.1: What's up, ketchup?#$b#Did you miss me, baby?$h#$e#I hope you did because I'm going to cuddle you so hard when we get to bed!$h#$b#That is, after I freshen up.$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Blair.2: Welcome home, babe!#$b#Miss me?$4#$e#I had the craziest day today!$s#$b#I really need a hug.$s
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Blair.3: How was your day, babe?#$b#I missed you!#$e#Oh, by the way, Trinnie and Keahi said the farm looked beautiful.$h#$b#They said they wanted to visit soon. Should we spend the day with them next time and give them a tour of the land?
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Blair.4: Ayayay, what a day!$7#$b#The best thing about coming home here is that I get to see your big face, babe!$h#$b#Haha, I love you!$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Blair.5: I'm back, babe!$h#$b#Phew, what's that smell?$u#$b#Babe, you smell like...#$b#Like someone in looooove.$4#$e#Haha, got you there, didn't I?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_0: Ayayay, I fear our little one might take after me.$u#$b#If so, we might have our hands full with this one.$7
Blair.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_1: Having a kid is something I didn't really see myself doing before.#$b#With all the stuff that happened to me before, I just thought bringing a kid into the world would be eh.#$b#But because of you, babe. I'm honestly enjoying motherhood.$4#$b#Thank you for coming into my life, babe.$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_2: Look at our little baby, @!$h#Our baby looks so cute, right?$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_3: Hey babe, do you wanna play a prank on our little love?$h#$b#We could hide when the %kid1 is not looking then wait till tears form %kid1's eyes then pop out!$h#$e#Ackk, is that too mean?$u
Blair.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_0: Ay dios mio, I just hope that these two don't take after me.$u#$b#If they do, our hands will definitely be full.$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_1: They're both so cute!$h#$b#We produce quite the offspring.$4#$b#It's like they won the genetic lottery!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_2: Hey, baby? Who do you love more, me or the kids?#$b#Haha! Just kidding, I just wanted to see you sweat because of the question, babe.$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_3: Awww, the kids look so happy.$h#$b#Maybe we could arrange a playdate with Sean, Keahi, and Trinnie!$h#$b#It'll be like the gang's back together, babe!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_0: What's up, my little bubble of happiness?$h#$b#I've been feeling a bit chipper today, would you like to do a happy dance with me?$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_1: I don't know what I did in my past life, but I sure am glad to have done something enough to deserve you, baby.$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_2: There are just some things that are super special which deserve to be shared with the world.#$b#One of those is you, @.$6#$b#Teehee.$6
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_3: You know what, babe? I've been thinking about making a treehouse.#$b#The kids would love it if we have one that would be open for everyone!$h#$b#We could even play hide and seek together!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_4: Babe, what do you think about making a fort?$h#$b#I saw a fort-making contest video yesterday, and I've been thinking about it ever since!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_5: Haha! Babe, I can't stop laughing!$h#$b#Keahi played the funniest prank on Sean!$h#$b#He cut Sean's trousers around the back so it looked like it has two buttholes!$h
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_6: I've been thinking about pitter-patter of little feet, babe.$6#$b#What do you say about making a home addition?$4
Blair.MarriageDialogue.Good_7: Babe!$u#$b#I lost something!$u#$b#But then I found you. Hihi!$6
